with ordered as (
  select collected_at, inst_id, sql_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0) as plan_hash_value,
    coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0) as elapsed_time_micro,
    coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0) as cpu_time_micro,
    coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0) as user_io_wait_micro,
    coalesce(application_wait_micro, 0) as application_wait_micro,
    coalesce(concurrency_wait_micro, 0) as concurrency_wait_micro,
    coalesce(cluster_wait_micro, 0) as cluster_wait_micro,
    coalesce(executions, 0) as executions,
    coalesce(buffer_gets, 0) as buffer_gets,
    coalesce(disk_reads, 0) as disk_reads,
    lag(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) over w as prev_elapsed,
    lag(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) over w as prev_cpu,
    lag(coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_user_io,
    lag(coalesce(application_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_application,
    lag(coalesce(concurrency_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_concurrency,
    lag(coalesce(cluster_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_cluster,
    lag(coalesce(executions, 0)) over w as prev_executions,
    lag(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) over w as prev_buffer_gets,
    lag(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) over w as prev_disk_reads
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  window w as (
    partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0)
    order by collected_at
  )
), deltas as (
  select sql_id,
    case when prev_elapsed is null then 0 when elapsed_time_micro >= prev_elapsed then elapsed_time_micro - prev_elapsed else elapsed_time_micro end as elapsed_delta,
    case when prev_cpu is null then 0 when cpu_time_micro >= prev_cpu then cpu_time_micro - prev_cpu else cpu_time_micro end as cpu_delta,
    case when prev_user_io is null then 0 when user_io_wait_micro >= prev_user_io then user_io_wait_micro - prev_user_io else user_io_wait_micro end as user_io_delta,
    case when prev_application is null then 0 when application_wait_micro >= prev_application then application_wait_micro - prev_application else application_wait_micro end as application_delta,
    case when prev_concurrency is null then 0 when concurrency_wait_micro >= prev_concurrency then concurrency_wait_micro - prev_concurrency else concurrency_wait_micro end as concurrency_delta,
    case when prev_cluster is null then 0 when cluster_wait_micro >= prev_cluster then cluster_wait_micro - prev_cluster else cluster_wait_micro end as cluster_delta,
    case when prev_executions is null then 0 when executions >= prev_executions then executions - prev_executions else executions end as executions_delta,
    case when prev_buffer_gets is null then 0 when buffer_gets >= prev_buffer_gets then buffer_gets - prev_buffer_gets else buffer_gets end as buffer_gets_delta,
    case when prev_disk_reads is null then 0 when disk_reads >= prev_disk_reads then disk_reads - prev_disk_reads else disk_reads end as disk_reads_delta
  from ordered
), consumers as (
  select sql_id,
    sum(elapsed_delta) as elapsed_micro,
    sum(cpu_delta) as cpu_micro,
    sum(user_io_delta) as user_io_micro,
    sum(application_delta) as application_micro,
    sum(concurrency_delta) as concurrency_micro,
    sum(cluster_delta) as cluster_micro,
    sum(executions_delta) as executions_delta,
    sum(buffer_gets_delta) as buffer_gets_delta,
    sum(disk_reads_delta) as disk_reads_delta
  from deltas
  group by sql_id
), ranked as (
  select *,
    rank() over (order by elapsed_micro desc) as elapsed_rank,
    rank() over (order by cpu_micro desc) as cpu_rank,
    rank() over (order by user_io_micro desc) as user_io_rank,
    rank() over (order by executions_delta desc) as executions_rank
  from consumers
  where elapsed_micro > 0
)
select r.sql_id, elapsed_rank, cpu_rank, user_io_rank, executions_rank,
  case
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) <= 0 then 'Other'
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) = cpu_micro then 'CPU'
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) = user_io_micro then 'User I/O'
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) = application_micro then 'Application'
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) = concurrency_micro then 'Concurrency'
    when greatest(cpu_micro, user_io_micro, application_micro, concurrency_micro, cluster_micro) = cluster_micro then 'Cluster'
    else 'Other'
  end as primary_pressure,
  round(elapsed_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as elapsed_seconds,
  round(cpu_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as cpu_seconds,
  round(user_io_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as user_io_seconds,
  round(application_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as application_seconds,
  round(concurrency_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as concurrency_seconds,
  round(cluster_micro / 1000000.0, 3) as cluster_seconds,
  executions_delta,
  round((elapsed_micro / 1000000.0) / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 6) as elapsed_seconds_per_exec,
  buffer_gets_delta, disk_reads_delta,
  case when t.sql_id is null then 'Not collected or aged out' else 'Available' end as sql_text_status,
  coalesce(p.plan_count, 0) as collected_plans,
  left(t.sql_fulltext, 240) as sql_preview
from ranked r
left join oracle_sql_texts t
  on t.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring} and t.sql_id = r.sql_id
left join lateral (
  select count(distinct (inst_id, child_number, plan_hash_value)) as plan_count
  from oracle_sql_plans p
  where p.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring} and p.sql_id = r.sql_id
) p on true
order by elapsed_rank
limit 20;

targets.rawSql:
with ordered as (
  select collected_at, inst_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0) as plan_hash_value,
    coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0) as elapsed_time_micro,
    coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0) as cpu_time_micro,
    coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0) as user_io_wait_micro,
    coalesce(application_wait_micro, 0) as application_wait_micro,
    coalesce(concurrency_wait_micro, 0) as concurrency_wait_micro,
    coalesce(cluster_wait_micro, 0) as cluster_wait_micro,
    lag(collected_at) over w as prev_collected_at,
    lag(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) over w as prev_elapsed,
    lag(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) over w as prev_cpu,
    lag(coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_user_io,
    lag(coalesce(application_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_application,
    lag(coalesce(concurrency_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_concurrency,
    lag(coalesce(cluster_wait_micro, 0)) over w as prev_cluster
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
  window w as (
    partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0)
    order by collected_at
  )
), per_scrape as (
  select collected_at,
    max(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at)) as interval_seconds,
    sum(case when prev_elapsed is null then null else
      (case when elapsed_time_micro >= prev_elapsed then elapsed_time_micro - prev_elapsed else elapsed_time_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as elapsed_aas,
    sum(case when prev_cpu is null then null else
      (case when cpu_time_micro >= prev_cpu then cpu_time_micro - prev_cpu else cpu_time_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as cpu_aas,
    sum(case when prev_user_io is null then null else
      (case when user_io_wait_micro >= prev_user_io then user_io_wait_micro - prev_user_io else user_io_wait_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as user_io_aas,
    sum(case when prev_application is null then null else
      (case when application_wait_micro >= prev_application then application_wait_micro - prev_application else application_wait_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as application_aas,
    sum(case when prev_concurrency is null then null else
      (case when concurrency_wait_micro >= prev_concurrency then concurrency_wait_micro - prev_concurrency else concurrency_wait_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as concurrency_aas,
    sum(case when prev_cluster is null then null else
      (case when cluster_wait_micro >= prev_cluster then cluster_wait_micro - prev_cluster else cluster_wait_micro end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at) * 1000000.0, 0) end) as cluster_aas
  from ordered
  group by collected_at
), per_minute as (
  select date_bin(interval '1 minute', collected_at, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') as bucket,
    sum(elapsed_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as elapsed_aas,
    sum(cpu_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as cpu_aas,
    sum(user_io_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as user_io_aas,
    sum(application_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as application_aas,
    sum(concurrency_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as concurrency_aas,
    sum(cluster_aas * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as cluster_aas
  from per_scrape
  group by 1
)
select bucket as "time", metric, value::double precision
from per_minute
cross join lateral (values
  ('Elapsed', elapsed_aas), ('CPU', cpu_aas), ('User I/O', user_io_aas),
  ('Application', application_aas), ('Concurrency', concurrency_aas), ('Cluster', cluster_aas)
) series(metric, value)
order by 1, 2;

with ordered as (
  select collected_at, inst_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0) as plan_hash_value,
    coalesce(executions, 0) as executions,
    coalesce(rows_processed, 0) as rows_processed,
    coalesce(parse_calls, 0) as parse_calls,
    lag(collected_at) over w as prev_collected_at,
    lag(coalesce(executions, 0)) over w as prev_executions,
    lag(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) over w as prev_rows,
    lag(coalesce(parse_calls, 0)) over w as prev_parses
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
  window w as (
    partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0)
    order by collected_at
  )
), per_scrape as (
  select collected_at,
    max(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at)) as interval_seconds,
    sum(case when prev_executions is null then null else
      (case when executions >= prev_executions then executions - prev_executions else executions end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as executions_per_second,
    sum(case when prev_rows is null then null else
      (case when rows_processed >= prev_rows then rows_processed - prev_rows else rows_processed end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as rows_per_second,
    sum(case when prev_parses is null then null else
      (case when parse_calls >= prev_parses then parse_calls - prev_parses else parse_calls end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as parses_per_second
  from ordered
  group by collected_at
), per_minute as (
  select date_bin(interval '1 minute', collected_at, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') as bucket,
    sum(executions_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as executions_per_second,
    sum(rows_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as rows_per_second,
    sum(parses_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as parses_per_second
  from per_scrape
  group by 1
)
select bucket as "time", metric, value::double precision
from per_minute
cross join lateral (values
  ('Executions / s', executions_per_second),
  ('Rows Processed / s', rows_per_second),
  ('Parse Calls / s', parses_per_second)
) series(metric, value)
order by 1, 2;

with ordered as (
  select collected_at, inst_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0) as plan_hash_value,
    coalesce(buffer_gets, 0) as buffer_gets,
    coalesce(disk_reads, 0) as disk_reads,
    coalesce(direct_writes, 0) as direct_writes,
    lag(collected_at) over w as prev_collected_at,
    lag(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) over w as prev_buffer_gets,
    lag(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) over w as prev_disk_reads,
    lag(coalesce(direct_writes, 0)) over w as prev_direct_writes
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
    and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
  window w as (
    partition by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, coalesce(plan_hash_value, 0)
    order by collected_at
  )
), per_scrape as (
  select collected_at,
    max(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at)) as interval_seconds,
    sum(case when prev_buffer_gets is null then null else
      (case when buffer_gets >= prev_buffer_gets then buffer_gets - prev_buffer_gets else buffer_gets end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as buffer_gets_per_second,
    sum(case when prev_disk_reads is null then null else
      (case when disk_reads >= prev_disk_reads then disk_reads - prev_disk_reads else disk_reads end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as disk_reads_per_second,
    sum(case when prev_direct_writes is null then null else
      (case when direct_writes >= prev_direct_writes then direct_writes - prev_direct_writes else direct_writes end) /
      nullif(extract(epoch from collected_at - prev_collected_at), 0) end) as direct_writes_per_second
  from ordered
  group by collected_at
), per_minute as (
  select date_bin(interval '1 minute', collected_at, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') as bucket,
    sum(buffer_gets_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as buffer_gets_per_second,
    sum(disk_reads_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as disk_reads_per_second,
    sum(direct_writes_per_second * interval_seconds) / nullif(sum(interval_seconds), 0) as direct_writes_per_second
  from per_scrape
  group by 1
)
select bucket as "time", metric, value::double precision
from per_minute
cross join lateral (values
  ('Buffer Gets / s', buffer_gets_per_second),
  ('Disk Reads / s', disk_reads_per_second),
  ('Direct Writes / s', direct_writes_per_second)
) series(metric, value)
order by 1, 2;

select s.inst_id, s.sql_id, s.child_number, s.plan_hash_value,
  min(s.collected_at) as first_seen, max(s.collected_at) as last_seen,
  count(*) as samples,
  max(s.executions) - min(s.executions) as executions_delta,
  round((max(coalesce(s.elapsed_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(s.elapsed_time_micro, 0))) / 1000000.0, 3) as elapsed_seconds_delta,
  case when exists (
    select 1 from oracle_sql_plans p
    where p.source_database = s.source_database
      and p.sql_id = s.sql_id
      and p.plan_hash_value = s.plan_hash_value
  ) then 'Available' else 'Not collected or aged out' end as plan_status
from oracle_sql_samples s
where $__timeFilter(s.collected_at)
  and s.source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and s.sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
group by s.source_database, s.inst_id, s.sql_id, s.child_number, s.plan_hash_value
order by last_seen desc, elapsed_seconds_delta desc;

panels.title: Selected SQL Full Text
panels.description: Complete Oracle SQL text for the SQL_ID selected in the dashboard variable.

Cached cursor-plan operations from GV$SQL_PLAN for the selected SQL_ID and plan hash. Operation colors classify access and join methods; they do not declare an operation good or bad. REVIEW_SIGNAL highlights full scans, Cartesian joins, temporary-space estimates, and unusually large optimizer estimates. Estimates are not ALLSTATS runtime values.

targets.rawSql:
select
  inst_id,
  child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  plan_line_id as id,
  parent_id,
  repeat('  ', greatest(coalesce(depth, 0), 0)::integer) || operation ||
    case when options is not null then ' ' || options else '' end as plan_operation,
  nullif(concat_ws(' | ',
    case
      when operation ilike '%CARTESIAN%' or options ilike '%CARTESIAN%'
        then 'CARTESIAN'
    end,
    case
      when operation = 'TABLE ACCESS' and options ilike '%FULL%'
        then 'FULL SCAN'
    end,
    case
      when coalesce(temp_space, 0) > 0
        then 'TEMP'
    end,
    case
      when coalesce(cardinality, 0) >= 100000
        or coalesce(bytes, 0) >= 104857600
        or coalesce(cost, 0) >= 10000
        then 'HIGH ESTIMATE'
    end
  ), '') as review_signal,
  concat_ws('.', object_owner, object_name) as object,
  object_type,
  cost,
  cardinality as estimated_rows,
  bytes as estimated_bytes,
  temp_space,
  partition_start,
  partition_stop,
  access_predicates,
  filter_predicates,
  last_referenced_at
from oracle_sql_plans
where source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  and sql_id = nullif(${sql_id:sqlstring}, '')
  and (nullif(${plan_hash_value:sqlstring}, '') is null
       or plan_hash_value::text = ${plan_hash_value:sqlstring})
order by inst_id, child_number, plan_hash_value, plan_line_id;
